entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: So? What brings you back here, after[n]all these years?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's a comprehensive study on[n]the research you tried to shut down[n]"all these years" ago.

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: I know how to read! What I meant was,[n]why are you bringing this to me now?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, this is just a quick visit out of spite.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I wanted to show you in person that I[n]found the "concrete evidence" you[n]had discontinued my research over.

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: ...So it appears. I'll admit you've[n]impressed me on that point,[n]at least...

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: But such praise does nothing now—all[n]this discussion is in the past. Why can't[n]you just let it stay there and move on?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, no can do, Professor. Cognitive[n]psience has made too great an impact[n]on this world to be abandoned like that.

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: What... What are you saying?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The psychotic-breakdown incidents,[n]the sudden changes of heart in adults[n]that the Phantom Thieves claim to make...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm nearly willing to call these events[n]"concrete evidence" of cognitive[n]psience in action—how about you?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And the one person pulling the strings[n]in the background of this...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Congressman Masayoshi Shido.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: He seems to be confessing to all sorts[n]of crimes now that the Phantom Thieves[n]have changed his heart.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Years ago, Shido took notice of my[n]research, stole it away from me, and[n]made others develop it for his own gain.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Not only that, he used cognitive psience[n]somehow to induce the politically[n]motivated psychotic breakdowns.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Now, you're heavily involved in that[n]series of events—aren't you?

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: What are... What are you planning[n]on doing with me?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, nothing at all. As I said before,[n]I only came here out of spite.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That paper—my work—is going to[n]change the world.

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: "Change the world"?

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: And where's the money for that? Where's[n]the power to do it? You're no Shido![n]What can someone like you actually do?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That paper there's just the first step.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've learned how to change the[n]cognition of not just an individual,[n]but all of humanity!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And I WILL do it, no matter how long[n]it takes!

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: Gahhh, enough of this drivel—get out of[n]my office! And, don't show your face[n]here again! Hear me?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: What... What is this?

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: Hmm?

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: What's your problem now?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Huh? You... You don't see this?[n]The sky just—

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: ...The time has come.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: This voice...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Wha—!?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: The time is finally at hand... I am the other[n]you, dwelling in the realm of mankind's[n]hearts.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The other... me? Wait—the realm of[n]mankind's hearts...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Are you telling me, this realm is...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: You may have no knowledge of it, but[n]I have been at your side for much[n]longer than our current meeting...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Finally, your reality and the sea of hearts[n]from which I came have truly become[n]one in this moment.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Now—the time for your unjustly[n]persecuted ideology is at hand.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: I am thou, thou art I...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's it... I... finally get it.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: To think it'd be so... Heheh...

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: Hey! What are you mumbling about!?

entries.speaker: Professor
entries.en: I told you to get out!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Yes. I'll be on my way.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Finally... Now, I can finally...
